verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins run inside Codex and ChatGPT, and users hand tasks to the built-in assistant through them. The docs describe it summarizing Slack channels and drafting replies, sending Messages on the user's behalf, scanning code for vulnerabilities, and scaffolding plugins via the built-in `@plugin-creator` skill. The assistant picks up a skill's full instructions on its own when it decides to use it, and community users confirm agents invoke skills either automatically or on request ("use the PR skill to open a PR"). missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of delegation quality for specific plugins, and clarity that the assistant belongs to the host product (Codex/ChatGPT) rather than the plugin layer itself.
